summary: test(shared): replace real-looking email addresses in test files
description:
Because:

- Test files and fixtures contain addresses that look like real people.

This commit:

- Replaces personal-looking addresses in fxa-settings, fxa-admin-panel,
  fxa-auth-server and fxa-content-server tests and fixtures with
  placeholders on reserved RFC 2606 domains (example.com, example.org).
- Keeps the gmail.com domain in the two popular-domain bucket tests,
  with a generic local part.

Closes FXA-14659
